propositions: Task and story both children of the same epic cannot hold a direct dependency; promotion to epic tier creates a self-blocking epic edge that should be rejected
Blocking link comparability should be determined by parent hierarchy structure, not ticket type tier, so cross-subtree dependencies escalate to nearest common ancestor's children
Redundancy check is applied before promotion using the original pair, allowing promoted pairs like epic-to-own-child to escape rejection
Ancestor walk with max_hops=2 cap truncates chains deeper than epic→story→task, feeding incorrect fallback behavior
Resolved blocking pair that is ancestor-descendant in either direction must be rejected as redundant, closing both direct parent-child and escalated ancestor cases
Non-blocking relations must retain original-pair redundancy semantics and gain no new rejections from structural comparability
